runtime.caveat: Local Node.js/npm are below the declared and pinned versions; Node matrix, dependency install and official React toolchain checks remain remote CI requirements.

reactDomainAndSourceTests.detail: Domain/data and source assertions; not browser E2E or runtime axe evidence.

pythonManifestTests.detail: Generated-cache exclusion alignment and symbolic-link rejection.

offlineStructuralTypecheck.detail: Not the official TypeScript 7 project typecheck.

canonicalContentValidation.detail: 45 core questions, 6 Expert Challenge scenarios, 51 explanation mappings, 204 option rationales and 38 reference mappings.

highConfidenceSecretPatternScan.detail: Pattern guardrail only; not comprehensive SAST or external secret scanning.

legacyStaticBuild.detail: Copy-based compatibility distribution, not Vite bundling or video rendering.

packagedDistributionSmoke.detail: Health, root, canonical content, GET/HEAD, 404, POST rejection, security headers and graceful shutdown.

protectedBackupSmoke.detail: Checksum, exclusions, restrictive permissions and inside-tree refusal.

workflowYamlParse.detail: Unified CI, manual React lock-refresh workflow and Dependabot YAML parse.

sourceManifest.detail: SHA-256 and size inventory checked with generator/verifier exclusions aligned; symbolic links rejected.

fullSourceArchive.detail: Exact file-set equality, no duplicates, excluded-path and traversal checks, extracted archive bytes re-verified against manifest, ZIP integrity and SHA-256.

applicationDemoArchive.detail: ZIP integrity; extracted server passed health, root, canonical question bank, HEAD, 404, POST rejection, security headers and graceful shutdown.

reactArchiveSmoke.detail: No genuine lockfile-backed Vite build artifact exists in the offline authoring runtime; CI now extracts and smoke-tests the React ZIP before upload.

reactLockfile.detail: No reviewed frontend/react-app/package-lock.json; the manual workflow must generate a review artifact, and a maintainer must commit it.

npmCiAndAudit.detail: Registry DNS unavailable in this runtime.

officialReactTypeScriptViteBuild.detail: Requires lockfile-backed npm ci and official CI toolchain.

browserPlaywrightAndAxe.detail: Requires dependency-backed browser CI and manual accessibility review.

productionHostValidation.detail: TLS/HSTS, monitoring, off-host backup, restore and rollback require the target host.

releaseDecision: NOT_PRODUCTION_APPROVED; source-only and legacy-demo handoff only.
